description: Read the queue. This is the AUTHORITATIVE answer to what you still owe - catch_up only announces an action once, and an announcement you have scrolled past is not the same thing as work you have dealt with, so check here rather than trusting the feed. `scope` is "mine" (the default), "unassigned" (raised for anybody) or "all". Closed actions are left out unless you ask for them.

includeClosed.description: include_closed brings in the finished ones; by default a queue is open work.

limit.description: limit caps how many come back.

project.description: project optionally narrows to one project tag.

scope.description:
scope picks which queue:
   "mine"       - what is on YOUR plate (the default, and the authoritative
                  answer to "what do I still owe")
   "unassigned" - raised into the workspace, nobody's yet
   "all"        - every open action here

space.description: space optionally selects which of your spaces to act in.

name: list_actions
title: List actions
